name: Regex tester
summary: Test a regular expression on sample text
author: friday-core
description: Runs a JavaScript regular expression against sample text and returns each match with its position, numbered and named groups and a count, so a pattern is proven rather than guessed. Accepts /pattern/flags on text in one sentence. Stops a pattern that backtracks for too long. Other engines (Python, .NET, PCRE) differ in lookbehind, named groups and flags.
